why: ask — the record's 'Not gluten-free' rests on the assertion that both signature products are wheat-flour cakes, and that is wrong for one of them. The operator's statutory allergen table gives 桐葉菓(とうようか) as もち粉-based with 「特定原材料 乳、卵」 and no 小麦, the same for the entire 餅 series, and 富久者有智 carries no 特定原材料 at all. No segregation or cross-contact control is documented anywhere on the site and the momiji-manju batter is wheat, so nothing above 'ask' is defensible — but 'no' tells a celiac on Miyajima there is nothing here, and the operator's own label says otherwise.
